_note: Team roster for ENGINEER '26. `members` is intentionally EMPTY. No team data exists anywhere in this repository, and team pages name real people in real roles — inventing placeholder names, photos or titles would attribute positions to people who may not hold them. Add real members here and the /team page groups and renders them automatically; no code change needed.

_memberShape.name: string — required, the person's real name
_memberShape.group: string — required; groups are DERIVED from this field, so only groups that actually have members will ever appear
_memberShape.image: string path or null — falls back to a typographic monogram tile when null
